ChainLevel.description: One level of a proposal's chain.

approvals.description:
The approvals so far, oldest first, one per principal (contract
1.29); at most [`MAX_LEVEL_APPROVALS`]. Absent reads as none: a
single-decider core names its decider in `by` only. Sent only when
there is one.

by.description:
Who decided, once approved or rejected: the approval that met
[`required`](Self::required), or the rejection.

required.description:
Approvals from distinct principals the level needs (contract 1.29):
1 to [`MAX_LEVEL_APPROVALS`]. Absent reads as 1, a single decider,
and a single decider is sent without it.

LevelApproval.description:
One principal's approval at a level. `by` is the principal's canonical
id, the same string as its `/whoami` `id` (never a display name),
compared byte for byte; a core dedupes a level's approvals on it.

LevelStatus.description: One level's place in the chain.

oneOf.description: The level does not require its approval.

PaneId.description: Stable id of one pane instance inside a layout.

ProposalKind.description: What a proposal asks to let through.

oneOf.description: A new catalog component or stored building block.

description:
Something waiting for approval, with its chain. Sent whole on every
change ([`PROPOSAL_UPDATED`](crate::bus::PROPOSAL_UPDATED)).

chain.description: Every level from the top down to `target_level`, in order.

current_level.description: The level whose turn it is; absent once decided.

proposed_by.description: The agent key or member that proposed it.

source_pane.description: The pane it came from, if any.

subject.description: What the decision applies to: a plan, component or grant id.

target_level.description:
The level the proposal targets; the chain runs from the top level
down to it.

version.description:
+1 on every change; a decision names the version it was made on and
the core refuses it on any other.

title: Proposal
